//: MOD UI text - English. This file may override the built-in strings.
win.title: Pilot Spawn Ratio
chk.portraits: Enable portrait replacement (use the local images in portraits\)
chk.lock: Lock the Female:Male ratio (kept when "{0}" changes)
hint.main: The Female/Male slider caps at 100 - "{0}"; the ratio box accepts 3:2 / 23:22, Enter applies.
ratio.label: Ratio  F : M
pool.off.empty: No portrait images found -> replacement cannot be enabled; the ratio works on its own (exactly as configured)
pool.off: Replacement is OFF -> vanilla portraits; the ratio works on its own, unaffected by images
pool.only: Only genders that have portraits are generated: available {0}
pool.note.other: ({0} has no portrait -> greyed out and never generated)
pool.note.fm: (F or M missing -> split / lock / ratio box all greyed out; the ratio has no effect)
pool.note.ok: (the ratio is renormalised within the available genders)
apply.fail: Applied (writing the config failed, see log):
rescan.emptyNote: (no images -> replacement was switched off automatically)
